simple: Privileged access management as a cloud service on the Idira platform (formerly CyberArk Privilege Cloud). Stores the passwords and SSH keys of administrator, service and local accounts in a protected vault and rotates them automatically — including after every use. Administrators connect to servers, databases and web consoles through a broker that isolates the session: the password never reaches their computer, and every session is recorded on video with a list of commands and short AI summaries. Built-in threat analytics (ITDR) spots credential theft, Kerberos attacks (Golden Ticket, DCSync), Pass-the-Hash and bulk password retrieval from the vault — and can end the session, rotate the password or require re-authentication. Licensed per user (Basic — without brokered connections, Standard, Enterprise); check the exact edition contents with your distributor.
